10k.note: 10-K describes a development-stage ophthalmic imaging device company plus two early planned drug-repurposing candidates (RTG-2023 dry AMD, RTG-2024 Alzheimer's); both are pre-IND with Avania Clinical only contracted as initial advisor. A Pearl IRB observational study on anti-VEGF response in wet AMD is ongoing but is not an interventional sponsor-led drug trial.
